Adventure & Outdoors
FROM WAVES TO WILDERNESS—ADVENTURE AWAITS IN ODISHA.
/
Experience
/
Adventure & Outdoors
RIDE THE COAST, EXPLORE FOREST TRAILS AND UNWIND IN IMMERSIVE ECO STAYS EXPERIENCE ODISHA’S OUTDOORS THROUGH ADVENTURE, NATURE AND RESPONSIBLE TRAVEL.
Adventure and Outdoor

Odisha’s diverse landscapes from its long coastline and vast wetlands to forested hills and rugged terrains make it an emerging destination for adventure seekers. Whether it’s riding the waves, trekking through scenic trails or camping under the stars, the state offers experiences that combine thrill with nature.

Here, adventure is not just about adrenaline it’s about exploring the outdoors in a way that is immersive, safe and sustainable.

Water & Coastal Experiences

From the Bay of Bengal to sprawling reservoirs and rivers, Odisha offers plenty of ways to enjoy the water.

Kayaking & Boating – Explore the calm waters of the Hirakud Reservoir and enjoy kayaking on the Mahanadi River at Debrigarh Nature Camp. 
Parasailing & Water Sports – Get your adrenaline pumping with parasailing, ATV rides and speed boating at Eco Retreat Odisha destinations like Konark, Chilika and Talasari.
Barkul Jetty, Chilika – Enjoy water scooters, towable tube rides or a peaceful boat ride across the lagoon.
Hirakud Reservoir – Experience exciting water sports near Jawahar Minar, one of western Odisha's popular adventure hubs.
Land Adventures

From forest trails to rugged hills, Odisha offers countless ways to experience the outdoors.

Trekking – Trekking activities in Daringbadi & the Eastern Ghats – Follow scenic trails through forests and rolling hills.
Off-Roading – Explore the rugged landscapes of Koraput, Kendujhar, and Mayurbhanj.
Jungle Safari – Venture into Odisha's forests on guided safaris at nature camps across the state.
Eco Retreats Odisha

Adventure in Odisha is deeply connected to nature. Eco Retreats reflect this ethos through premium glamping experiences set along pristine beaches and scenic landscapes. Alongside serene stays, guests can enjoy high energy activities like parasailing and jet skiing all conducted under the supervision of trained personnel. Designed with a focus on sustainability, community participation and responsible tourism, these experiences offer a seamless blend of comfort, thrill and the outdoors making every stay both exciting and meaningful

Safety & Responsible Adventure
Odisha is strengthening its adventure ecosystem with a strong focus on safety, standards and sustainability.
Implementation of the comprehensive 2025 Adventure Tourism Guidelines
State is deploying trained professionals and certified guides for activities to ensure high safety standards
Institutions like OSWALI are actively training lifesavers and water safety personnel to national standards
Travellers can explore with confidence, knowing that safety and sustainability go hand in hand under the new policy framework.

Culture, Music & Dance
WHERE TRADITION MOVES, MUSIC LIVES, AND CULTURE THRIVES
/

Culture, Music & Dance
DISCOVER THE RICH TAPESTRY OF ODISHA’S PERFORMING ARTS - WHERE EVERY MOVEMENT, MELODY AND RHYTHM TELLS A STORY OF LIVING HERITAGE.
Culture, Music - Dance
Odisha’s cultural landscape is a vibrant expression of its history, spirituality and community life. From classical dance forms to folk traditions, music and storytelling, culture here is not just preserved it is performed, lived and celebrated every day. 
For travellers this offers an opportunity to experience a living heritage where rhythm, movement and expression come together in powerful and immersive ways.
Odissi Classical Dance Traditions
Odisha is the birthplace of Odissi, one of India’s oldest classical dance forms.
It is known for graceful movements, sculptural poses and expressive storytelling 
The dance is deeply rooted in temple traditions and devotional themes 
Performed on national and global stages, yet closely tied to its origins
Experiencing Odissi offers a glimpse into the state’s refined artistic legacy.
Folk Music & Dance

Moving beyond the classical, Odisha’s folk traditions are energetic, diverse and deeply connected to the land. 

Sambalpuri Folk Dance & Music - Vibrant performances reflecting life in western Odisha
Dalkhai & Karma - Popular folk dances performed during festivals and community gatherings
Mayurbhanj Chhau - A dynamic dance form blending martial arts, storytelling and dramatic expression

These performances are spontaneous, immersive and rooted in community participation.

Tribal Rhythms & Expressions
In tribal regions, music and dance are an integral part of everyday life.
Performed during rituals, harvests and social gatherings
Characterised by rhythmic beats, traditional instruments and group performances
Reflect a deep connection with nature, seasons and community identity
These experiences are raw, authentic and deeply engaging.
Theatre & Storytelling
Storytelling in Odisha transcends the written word.
Dhanu Jatra offers the world’s largest open air theatre experience.
Traditional performances like Sahi Jatra and Pala immerse audience in local narratives.
Legends, myths and folk tales are brought alive through music, dialogue and dramatic expression.
Theatre here is a living tradition, blending performance with community participation..
Cultural Experiences
Odisha offers multiple ways to experience its performing arts:
Live performances at cultural festivals and events
Village and community based experiences in rural and tribal regions
Interactive sessions and workshops with local artists
These encounters go beyond mere observation allowing travellers to connect deeply with the art and the artists.

Odisha Walks
STEP INTO THE STORIES, STREETS AND SOUL OF ODISHA
/
Experience

Odisha Walks
LET’S WALK AND EXPERIENCE ODISHA.
Odisha Walks
Odisha Walks is a guided heritage initiative by Odisha Tourism that invites visitors to experience the state beyond sightseeing and step into its living legacy. Through thoughtfully curated walking trails, it brings alive Odisha’s timeless temples, historic landmarks, cultural traditions and local stories with the guidance of knowledgeable storytellers. From the grandeur of Kalinga architecture to the rhythms of everyday heritage, Odisha Walks offers an immersive journey that connects the past with the present, making every walk a meaningful discovery of the state’s rich heritage, culture and spirit. Come together to walk, explore and experience the spirit of Odisha.
ODISHA WALKS
Bhubaneswar
Architectural Heritage & Temple Walk Explore why Bhubaneswar is called the Temple City of India, a destination known as the Ekamra Khetra. This immersive trail decodes Kalinga temple architecture through icons like Mukteswar, Rajarani, Brahmeswar and Lingaraj. From design evolution to sacred urban planning, experience how faith, art and engineering shaped the city.
Duration: 2-3 Hours (6 AM - 8 AM)
Museum Trail A curated journey through Odisha’s culture, nature and knowledge systems. From archaeology at Odisha State Museum to the biodiversity at the Regional Museum of Natural History and from traditional crafts at Kala Bhoomi to astronomy at Pathani Samanta Planetarium this trail seamlessly blends learning with experience.
Duration: 3 Hours (10 AM - 12 PM)
Path of Compassion Dhauli Walk through history where Emperor Ashoka chose peace over war. Explore the ancient Dhauli Rock Edicts and the serene Shanti Stupa while reflecting on themes of non-violence, ethics and transformation. A deeply introspective experience rooted in global history.
Duration: 2 Hours (4 PM - 6 PM)
Udayagiri–Khandagiri Cave Walk Step into ancient Kalinga’s global past through these Jain rock-cut caves. Discover monastic life, the Hathigumpha inscription and stories of King Kharavela. A powerful mix of history, philosophy and panoramic views.
Duration: 2 Hours (8 AM - 10 AM)
ODISHA WALKS
Similipal
Sitakund Gorge Trail  A slow morning journey into the forests of Similipal, where the sounds of birds, ancient rocks, flowing water and local folklore come together to tell the story of the landscape. From the misty Sitakund waterfall and a cup of warm Mahua tea to conversations about forest traditions and quiet moments of reflection, this trail invites guests to experience the forest at an unhurried pace.
Speaking to Ancestors Trail  An evening spent exploring the stories and traditions of Mayurbhanj, beginning at the serene Balidiha Dam and ending under a starlit sky in a Santhal village. Along the way, guests discover the vision of the Mayurbhanj kings, the importance of the Mahua tree, the warmth of village hospitality, traditional music and dance, and age-old ways of reading the stars and understanding the natural world. 
ODISHA WALKS
Sambalpur
Sambalpur Heritage Trail Trace the roots of Sambalpur—from ancient Dakshin Kosala to the diamond rich Hirakhand legacy. Explore sacred sites like the Maa Samaleswari Temple and uncover stories of history, faith, and identity.  
Duration: 2 Hours 
Debrigarh Nature Trail A guided safari through Debrigarh Wildlife Sanctuary. Spot Indian bison, sambhar deer, and rich birdlife while enjoying sweeping views of the Hirakud Reservoir. The sanctuary is Ideal for wildlife and nature enthusiasts.  
Duration: 2 Hours  
Hirakud Crafts Trail Visit Kardola, a weaving village keeping Sambalpuri Ikat alive. Interact with master weavers and explore nearby landmarks like the chime filled Ghanteswari Temple and the scenic Chipilima waterfall. This experience offers a blend of handloom craft, local culture, and tranquil rural life.  
Duration: 2 Hours 
ODISHA WALKS
Kataka
Kataka Museum Trail Discover Odisha’s maritime legacy at the Odisha State Maritime Museum along the Mahanadi River. Continue to the Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose’s birthplace Museum and the Museum of Justice and where history comes alive in Kataka. 
Duration: 2 Hours (Morning) 
Silver Filigree (Tarakasi) Trail Explore Kataka’s 500-year-old silver filigree craft, locally known as Tarakasi. Witness intricate designs, interact with artisans and understand why Tarakasi holds a GI tag for its intricate craftsmanship and cultural significance in Odisha. 
Duration: 2 Hours (Morning)
ODISHA WALKS
Puri
Golden Beach & Lighthouse Trail Experience Puri’s iconic coastline at the Blue Flag Golden Beach. Watch stunning sunsets and explore the historic lighthouse where coastal beauty meets maritime legacy.
Duration: 2 Hours
Art, Craft & Tradition Trail Walk through Puri’s artisan lanes and discover living craft traditions from Pattachitra to stone carving and solapith. Meet artisans, watch live demos and experience heritage in action.
Duration: 2 Hours
Puri Food Trail Dive into Puri’s legendary food culture shaped by the Jagannath Temple kitchen one of the largest in the world. Taste Mahaprasad and explore how faith influences regional cuisine.
Duration: 2 Hours
Puri Heritage Trail Explore the living heritage around the Jagannath Temple. From rituals and festivals to art, music and local life this trail captures the essence of Puri as a cultural and spiritual epicentre.
Duration: 2 Hours

Sports Tourism
GLOBAL SPORTING HUB
Redefining Sporting Excellence

Odisha has rapidly emerged as India’s leading sports destination, combining world-class infrastructure with a strong vision for global sporting excellence. From hosting major international tournaments to developing high-performance training ecosystems the state is redefining how sport connects with travel. 

Beyond stadiums, sports tourism in Odisha extends into coastal runs, adventure activities and immersive experiences offering visitors a chance to engage with both sport and destination in meaningful ways.

CHAMPIONING THE FUTURE
Global Sporting Hub
Hosting world-class events on a global stage.
Hosting major international events including the FIH Hockey World Cup (2018 & 2023). 
Serving as a regular venue for global tournaments like FIH Hockey League and Asian Athletics events. 
Upcoming international events like the World Athletics Indoor Championship in 2028, which strengthens Odisha’s global sporting presence. 
Attracting athletes, teams, and spectators from across the world
Building Odisha’s identity as a premier sports destination. 
BUILT FOR EXCELLENCE
World-Class Infrastructure
Built for performance, designed for excellence
Kalinga Stadium, Bhubaneswar - a premier multi-sport complex hosting global events
Birsa Munda International Hockey Stadium - one of the world’s largest fully seated hockey stadiums
Barabati Stadium, Kataka - a historic venue for major sporting events
A network of stadiums and training facilities across the state
Continuous investment in modern sports infrastructure
NURTURING TALENT
High-Performance Ecosystem
Nurturing talent through elite training systems
11+ High-Performance Centres across multiple sports disciplines
Focuses on hockey, athletics, badminton, weightlifting and more 
Provides professional coaching, sports science and athlete development programs 
Maintains a dedicated facilities supporting national and international athletes 
Maintains a strong pipeline for grassroots to elite-level sports development 
GROWTH THROUGH SPORT
Economic & Tourism Impact

Drives growth through sport-led tourism
Increases footfall from international and domestic visitors
Boosts hospitality, transport and local businesses
Creates employment opportunities through sports and allied sectors
Strengthens destination branding - “Think India, Think Odisha”
Positions sports as a gateway to explore culture, nature and cuisine

DISTRICTS THAT SHAPE THE COAST
Where the Ocean Meets Eternity

East Odisha is where history, culture and nature converge in a breathtaking coastal tapestry. Here temple bells echo alongside the ceaseless waves of the Bay of Bengal, and every journey feels timeless.

At the heart of this region lies the Golden Triangle of Odisha - Bhubaneswar, Puri and Konark each a window into the state’s spiritual and architectural heritage. From the soaring spires of the Lingaraj Temple in Bhubaneswar to the devotional energy of Puri’s Jagannath Temple and the breathtaking beauty of the UNESCO-listed Sun Temple at Konark, East Odisha is a celebration of sacred spaces, artistry and devotion.

Beyond the monuments, the coast and wetlands reveal the state’s natural grandeur. Chilika Lake (Satapada), Asia’s largest brackish water lagoon, is home to rare Irrawaddy dolphins and hundreds of migratory bird species make Mangalajodi their wintering home. Further north, Bhitarkanika National Park immerses visitors in lush mangroves and the realm of the mighty saltwater crocodile.

From the Diamond Triangle of ancient Buddhist ruins to the intricate silver filigree of Kataka, East Odisha offers experiences that are culturally enriching, visually stunning and deeply memorable.

DISTRICTS THAT SHAPE THE COAST
Where Nature and Heritage Converge

Central Odisha is a land where winding rivers carve through verdant forests and fertile plains, creating a mosaic of natural beauty and historic significance. The region’s landscapes are punctuated by dense forests, sacred rivers and ancient temples, while its towns and villages reflect a living cultural heritage shaped by centuries of dynasties and local traditions. Dhenkanal, with its scenic hills and royal palaces, stands as a testament to the region’s regal past.

Joranda in Dhenkanal district is the spiritual seat of Mahima Gadi, the heart of the Mahima Dharma tradition, offering visitors a glimpse into one of Odisha’s distinctive religious practices, where the principles of Mahima Dharma invite reflection and a deeper connection with the Brahmand (universe). While Anugola’s river valleys and Boudh’s Buddhist remnants offer glimpses into Odisha’s spiritual and historical depth. Nayagada’s scenic countryside and the historic Ladukeswar Temple further enrich the tapestry of Central Odisha, making it a destination where nature, history and culture intertwine.

DISTRICTS THAT SHAPE THE COAST
Where Wilderness Shapes the Journey

North Odisha is a land of primal nature and royal elegance, where emerald forests rise into sacred hills and the coast reveals surreal tidal landscapes. At the heart of the region lies the Similipal Biosphere Reserve, one of India’s most vital tiger and elephant habitats. Mist-shrouded Sal forests and roaring waterfalls like Barehipani and Joranda create a symphony of nature, while the cultural heartbeat of Mayurbhanj comes alive through its royal heritage and the heroic rhythms of Chhau dance, a masked martial performance unique to the region

As the rolling hills descend toward the sea, the landscape unfolds into the coastal charm of Baleshwar. Here, Chandipur Beach reveals the mesmerizing ‘Vanishing Sea’ phenomenon, where the tide recedes several kilometres to expose the shimmering seabed. Nearby, the tranquil shores of Talsari and the mangrove-fringed Bichitrapur offer a unique coastal experience, where whistling casuarina groves meet the playful scuttling of red crabs.

Maa Kichakeswari Temple at Khiching offers a profound spiritual experience. Crafted entirely from black chlorite stone, it stands as a remarkable example of temple reconstruction in India. Nearby, the sacred Kshirachora Gopinath Temple at Remuna draws pilgrims from far and wide, where devotion flows as freely as the temple’s legendary ‘stolen milk’ prasad, offering a timeless glimpse into Odisha’s spiritual heritage. While the old ports along the coast remind visitors of a rich maritime legacy. From the tribal heartlands of Kendujhar, home to the Gonasika hills and the sacred origin of the Baitarani River, to secluded coastal hamlets, North Odisha invites explorers to discover a world where wilderness, heritage and tribal culture intertwine.

DISTRICTS THAT SHAPE THE COAST
Where Rugged Landscape meets Living Tradition

West Odisha is a land of rugged beauty, rich heritage and vibrant traditions, where the undulating peaks of the Gandhamardan Hills meet the expansive valleys carved by the Mahanadi River. Anchored by the engineering marvel of Hirakud Dam, one of the world’s longest earthen dams, the region combines wilderness, history and culture in every experience.

In Sambalpur, the west’s cultural heartbeat, the rhythmic beats of the Dhol and Nishan accompany the iconic Sambalpuri Ikat, a textile heritage that weaves stories of the land into every thread. Spirituality blends seamlessly with nature at the foot of Gandhamardan, Nrusinghanath and Harishankar Temples flank the hill famed for medicinal flora, waterfalls and crystal streams. Further south, Patali Srikhetra in Subarnapur tells the secret history of Lord Jagannath’s concealment during invasions. Wildlife enthusiasts can explore Debrigarh Wildlife Sanctuary, home to leopards, Indian bison and four-horned antelopes. From the handloom clusters of Baragada to the misty cascades of Debagada, West Odisha offers an authentic, untamed journey for travelers who seek culture, nature and heritage.

DISTRICTS THAT SHAPE THE COAST
Where Nature Whispers Ancient Stories

South Odisha is a majestic land of mist-covered hills, rolling valleys and serene coastlines, where tribal heritage and natural wonders intertwine. At the heart of this region lies Koraput, a high-altitude sanctuary scented with eucalyptus and coffee blossoms. Here, the Deomali Hills, Odisha’s highest peak, rise into clouds, offering panoramic vistas, while weekly tribal markets (hata) showcase the living traditions of communities unchanged for millennia. Nature reveals its raw power at the Duduma Waterfall, plunging into deep river gorges along the Machkund, a spectacle of sheer wilderness.

From the misty hills of South Odisha, the terrain gently slopes toward serene coastal plains. Tampara Lake and Gopalpur on Sea welcome travellers with golden sands and tranquil waters, where the remnants of colonial architecture whisper tales of maritime glory. The region is also an ecological treasure the Rushikulya Rookery hosts hundreds of thousands of Olive Ridley sea turtles, performing a miraculous, synchronized nesting ritual. Spirituality is anchored at Tara Tarini, a hilltop Tantric shrine overlooking the Rushikulya River. From the spice gardens of Kandhamala to the silk weaving clusters of Brahmapur, South Odisha invites travellers into a world of hills, forests, coastlines and deeply rooted tribal culture.

TRAVEL PLANNER
Best Time to Visit Odisha

Odisha is a year-round destination, but each season offers a unique experience. Discover the perfect time for your journey.

October to March

The Golden Season • Peak Tourist Time

This is undoubtedly the best time to explore Odisha. The weather is pleasant, dry, and cool, making it perfect for temple hopping, wildlife safaris, and beach activities.

 10°C - 27°C
 Sunny & Pleasant
PEAK SEASON
Winter

OCTOBER - FEBRUARY

Cool, dry, and extremely pleasant. The skies are clear, and the humidity is low. Ideal for all kinds of tourism activities.

PERFECT FOR:
Temple visits in Bhubaneswar & Puri
Bird watching at Chilika Lake (Migratory
birds)
Camping and Trekking
Beach festivals and cultural events
WHAT TO PACK:
Light Woolens
Cotton Outfits
Comfortable Shoes
OFF-PEAK
Summer

MARCH - JUNE

Temperatures can soar, often crossing 40°C. However, it's the best time to visit waterfalls and hill stations like Daringbadi to escape the heat.

PERFECT FOR:
Visiting Hill Stations (Koraput)
Early morning temple darshans
Experiencing Raja Parba festival
Evening strolls by the beach
 
WHAT TO PACK:
Cotton/Linen
Sunscreen
Hat & Sunglasses
SHOULDER SEASON
Monsoon

JULY - SEPTEMBER

Odisha transforms into a lush green paradise. Frequent rains bring relief from the heat. Nature lovers and photographers will love the vibrant landscapes.

PERFECT FOR:
Nature Photography
Visiting Waterfalls (at their fullest)
Enjoying scenic drives
Attending the Grand Ratha Jatra (June/July)
WHAT TO PACK:
Umbrella/Raincoat
Waterproof Shoes
Quick-dry Clothes
